# AAA Awning Co., Inc.

> Custom fabric and metal awning, canopy, and shade-structure fabrication and
> installation across Texas. Family-run since 1984, headquartered in Houston.
> Services include residential patio awnings, retractable awnings, metal
> awnings, extruded aluminum canopies, walkway covers, carports, gazebos,
> cabanas, shade structures, shade sails, patio curtains, and exterior
> motorized screens. Sunbrella Preferred Partner. Service area: Houston,
> Dallas, Fort Worth, Austin, San Antonio metros plus the Texas Gulf Coast
> (Galveston, Corpus Christi).

## Company facts

- Name: AAA Awning Co., Inc.
- Founded: 1984
- Headquarters: 8810 Madie Drive, Houston, TX 77022
- Dallas office: 2511 Prairie Creek Dr. West, Richardson, TX 75080 (by appointment)
- Austin office: phone only — (512) 459-1540
- Main phone: (713) 694-3930
- Dallas phone: (214) 553-0733
- Email: admin@aaaawning.net
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
- Sunbrella Preferred Partner — authorized awning fabric distributor
- Family-run; all installs done by AAA employees, no subcontractors

## Services

- Fabric awnings (Sunbrella canvas, vinyl, shade cloth)
- Metal awnings (standing-seam, R-panel, corrugated, Kynar 500 finishes)
- Extruded aluminum awnings, walkway covers, and canopies
- Retractable awnings (motorized and manual)
- Canopies (commercial, hospitality, drive-thru, entry)
- Carports (steel and aluminum)
- Gazebos and cabanas (residential and hospitality)
- Shade structures (schools, parks, commercial)
- Shade sails (tensioned fabric)
- Patio curtains (canvas, vinyl, mesh)
- Exterior motorized screens
- Custom awning shapes and printed graphics
- Hurricane-rated coastal-grade installations
- Post-storm damage assessment and repair
- Re-covering existing awning frames with new fabric

## Service-area cities (all with dedicated landing pages)

Houston metro + Gulf Coast: Houston, The Woodlands, Sugar Land, Katy, Pearland,
League City, Galveston, Corpus Christi.

Dallas metro: Dallas, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Richardson, Highland Park &
University Park (Park Cities), Allen, Rockwall.

Fort Worth metro: Fort Worth, Arlington, Southlake, Keller, Colleyville,
Grapevine, Westlake, Mansfield.

Austin metro: Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Lakeway &amp; Bee
Cave &amp; West Lake Hills, Kyle.

San Antonio metro: San Antonio, Alamo Heights, Stone Oak, New Braunfels,
Boerne, Schertz.
